Unlike subsections, like the Filesystem Hierarchy Standard which merely regulates where components have to be available in a compliant system, the LSB standard in its whole is a committee standard with dwindling importance in pratice.

The LSB has been criticized for not taking input from projects, most notably the Debian project, outside the sphere of its member companies. [S]
